requirements.statement: I want a companion app that helps testrunner run tests external to token calls. It can be written in go. It needs to be language agnostic e.g. can run rust tests, python tests, etc. It maintains a text based database or sqlite database per project so that it knows exactly what test cases to run and run through and how to get them. A pass is just a pass. We don't even need to tell the AI TestMaster that it passed. A failure is a failure and we should capture the failure output and give that to a file that TestMaster then can go read about the full test. So it should run through the full test cases until there's a blocking test. But if we had 300 tests that are meant to be ran independent, then it runs through all 300 and then it tells TestMaster only of the failures. It can tell it statistics on passing, but I don't need the TestMaster actually seeing and looking at the test.

requirements.statement: Keep skill backups out of the include glob, for example in ~/.ssh/config.d-backups/<site>.<UTC>. Make the verify step fail when ssh -G resolves options from any file other than the live site files. Have list or sort report duplicate Host names within a site.

requirements.statement: Chop-ups need to happen in logical spots. And consolidation needs to happen in logical spots. I really do think we need to be in order in respecting the dependency order in the status bar. I need the skills that built those plans and the skills that built the milestone documents to be smarter.

Plan letters in the iterate graph and every consumer (status bar, dashboard, Claude Code status line): (1) plans are listed in execution order, respecting depends: — a plan never appears before a plan it depends on; (2) each plan shows the first letter of its codename, never a position label A–Z; (3) the letter is upper case when the plan is teamed and lower case when not; (4) the letter's color is the plan's status; a label: line in a plan file is ignored, and a project with more than 26 live plans is not an error.
